description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Election of new Vice Chairmen for the Velvettithurai U/C
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting for the election to fill the vacancy of Vice Chairman of the Valvettithurai Urban Council. It is issued under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act and pertains directly to an electoral process at the local government level, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette.
